sub_graphs.title: EIP-1898: State Query with Block Identifier
sub_graphs.description: Models the lifecycle of JSON-RPC state queries using the enhanced block parameter

nodes.label: JSON-RPC Request Received
nodes.description: State query request received (eth_getBalance, eth_getStorageAt, eth_call, etc.)

nodes.label: Parse Block Parameter
nodes.description: Parse the block parameter which can be hex string, tag, or object with blockNumber/blockHash

nodes.label: Block Parameter Parsed
nodes.description: Block identifier has been extracted (number, hash, or tag like latest/earliest/pending)

nodes.label: Lookup Block
nodes.description: Find the specified block by number or hash in the chain database

nodes.label: Block Found
nodes.description: The specified block exists in the node's database

nodes.label: Block Not Found
nodes.description: The specified block does not exist, return error -32001

nodes.label: Check Canonical Status
nodes.description: If requireCanonical is true, verify block is on the canonical chain

nodes.label: Block is Canonical
nodes.description: Block is on the canonical chain, proceed with query

nodes.label: Block is Non-Canonical
nodes.description: Block exists but is not canonical, return error -32000 if requireCanonical=true

nodes.label: Execute State Query
nodes.description: Execute the actual state query (getBalance, getCode, etc.) at the specified block

nodes.label: Query Result Ready
nodes.description: State data has been retrieved and is ready to return to client

edges.label: Lookup block by number or hash
Block not canonical and requireCanonical=true, error -32000

external_entities.name: JSON-RPC Client
external_entities.description: External application querying Ethereum state via JSON-RPC

sub_graphs.title: EIP-1898: Block Parameter Validation
sub_graphs.description: Models the validation rules for the enhanced block parameter format

nodes.label: Raw Block Parameter Received
nodes.description: Block parameter has been received, format unknown

nodes.label: Detect Parameter Format
nodes.description: Determine if parameter is hex string, tag string, or object

nodes.label: Legacy Hex Format Detected
nodes.description: Parameter is a QUANTITY hex string (block number)

nodes.label: Tag Format Detected
nodes.description: Parameter is a tag: earliest, latest, pending, safe, finalized

nodes.label: Object Format Detected
nodes.description: Parameter is object with blockNumber, blockHash, requireCanonical fields

nodes.label: Validate Object Fields
nodes.description: Ensure blockNumber and blockHash are not both present, validate types

nodes.label: Parameter Valid
nodes.description: Block parameter passes all validation checks

nodes.label: Parameter Invalid
nodes.description: Block parameter fails validation

edges.label: Block parameter included in RPC request
Object fields invalid (both blockNumber and blockHash present)

sub_graphs.title: EIP-1898: Error Handling for Block Queries
sub_graphs.description: Models the error conditions and responses for block-based queries

nodes.label: Query In Progress
nodes.description: State query is being processed with block identifier

nodes.label: Check Block Exists
nodes.description: Verify the specified block exists in the node's database

nodes.label: Error: Block Not Found
nodes.description: Return JSON-RPC error code -32001 with appropriate message

nodes.label: Check Canonical If Required
nodes.description: If requireCanonical=true, verify block is on canonical chain

nodes.label: Error: Block Not Canonical
nodes.description: Return JSON-RPC error code -32000 with appropriate message

nodes.label: Proceed With Query
nodes.description: All checks passed, continue with state query execution

ambiguities.text: The specification does not clarify behavior when both blockNumber and blockHash are omitted from the object parameter.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume this should be treated as an invalid parameter and return an appropriate error. Implementations should validate that at least one is present.

ambiguities.text: The interaction between requireCanonical and the 'pending' tag is not specified.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume requireCanonical has no effect when used with 'pending' since pending state is inherently not finalized.

ambiguities.text: Error message content for -32001 and -32000 errors is not standardized.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume implementations may use their own error message text as long as error codes are correct.

implicit_assumptions.description: The node has access to historical state data for the requested block.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Queries for pruned state may fail even if the block header exists, leading to inconsistent behavior.

implicit_assumptions.description: Clients trust the canonical chain determination made by the node.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: A compromised or misconfigured node could report incorrect canonical status, leading clients to trust non-canonical state.

implicit_assumptions.description: Block hash uniquely identifies a block and its state across all forks.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Hash collisions (theoretically possible but computationally infeasible) could lead to incorrect state being returned.
